changelog: BIM-Bot v2.7.0 — ChatGPT Desktop auto-connect. NEW: the installer, every Revit start, and the 'Connect Claude' ribbon button now register BIM-Bot in ChatGPT Desktop automatically (%USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml, [mcp_servers.BIM-Bot]) — no manual setup; all 230 tools appear in ChatGPT after a restart. Only the BIM-Bot table is edited (other ChatGPT settings untouched, .bimbot-backup written first); stale paths are repaired; longer startup/tool timeouts for large Revit operations. Uninstall removes the ChatGPT entry too (now 9 MCP client configs). bimbot-doctor.ps1 checks the ChatGPT entry. The mcp-config.chatgpt.json sample is replaced by mcp-config.chatgpt.toml (ChatGPT reads TOML, not JSON).
